name: Journaling
description: Journaling word search puzzles gather pen and page English for adults and seniors — entry, ink, habit, gratitude, margin and quiet desk words — without notebook brands. Every puzzle is free in the browser with no download and no timer. Easy grids warm up across and down; medium adds diagonals; hard hides words in eight directions; large print keeps letters generous. The bank favors honest daily-life nouns: lamp, chair, prompt, reflect and review sit beside longer anchors such as gratitude and journal. This hub sits under Reading and pairs well with Libraries, Calligraphy, Mindfulness and Meditation for a soft writing evening. Start with large print if smaller type tires the eyes, or read how to play before your first page.
